Iggy's Reckin' Balls.name: Iggy's Reckin' Balls
Iggy's Reckin' Balls.summary: A vertical race up towering tracks. Iggy and the Reckin' Balls are in the race of their lives. A winner-take-all dash to the top of twisted, looped, warped and genuinely demented courses! Smash, crash and swing with Iggy, his friends, plus loads of secret characters. Over 100 tracks, tons of shortcuts, secret paths, loops and elevators. One to four player racing action with Battle and Versus mode.

J.League Live 64.name: J.League Live 64
J.League Live 64.summary: J.League Live 64 is a soccer game for the Nintendo 64. It was released only in Japan in 1997. The game has officially licensed players and teams from Japan's J. League. The game was developed by EA and published in the west as Fifa Soccer 64.
